system_description.narrative_title: Nvidia CEO spy-affair probe and its geopolitical–market fallout
system_description.narrative_summary: A reported romantic relationship between Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and an alleged Chinese spy has triggered an internal board probe and cascading scrutiny from US lawmakers, intelligence actors, investors and the media. Treated as an open system, information flows (leaks, reporting, hearings), capital flows (stock trades, derivatives, sector rotation) and policy-signalling (congressional oversight, potential export limits, lawsuits) interact across corporate, political and financial boundaries, producing reinforcing and balancing feedbacks that amplify reputational, regulatory and market impacts. The episode exposes systemic dependencies on a single industry leader and links private conduct to state-level security concerns in the US–China technology rivalry.
system_description.scope: Nvidia Inc., CEO Jensen Huang, the company board and governance processes, the internal probe, US congressional and intelligence scrutiny, investor and market responses (stock, derivatives), media reporting, related lawsuits and potential policy/regulatory responses tied to China–US tech and security concerns.
system_description.super_system: Global semiconductor/AI technology ecosystem embedded in US–China strategic competition and national-security policy regimes.
adjacent_subsystems: US political oversight and intelligence apparatus (Congress, FBI, IC)
Global financial markets and investor ecosystem (equities, options, short sellers)
China's state/intelligence apparatus and technology policy
Corporate governance, legal and regulatory frameworks (boards, securities law, export controls)

variables.name: Information flow rate
variables.description: Measures the volume and velocity of leaked, reported, and circulated information about the system per unit time.

variables.name: Media attention
variables.description: Measures the prominence and intensity of coverage across news and social media channels related to the system.

variables.name: Investor sentiment level
variables.description: Measures prevailing positive or negative attitudes and expectations among market participants toward the firm/sector.

variables.name: Market price volatility
variables.description: Measures the magnitude and frequency of short-term price fluctuations in securities linked to the firm/sector.

variables.name: Capital flow to sector
variables.description: Measures net inflows and outflows of investment capital into the relevant industry or asset class over time.

variables.name: Derivatives exposure
variables.description: Measures the scale of open interest, leverage and contingent positions in derivatives tied to the firm/sector.

variables.name: Governance resilience
variables.description: Measures the board and management system's capacity to absorb shocks, manage conflicts, and maintain decision-making continuity.

variables.name: Key-person dependency
variables.description: Measures the degree to which organizational performance and strategic direction rely on one or a few individuals.

variables.name: Reputational capital
variables.description: Measures the accumulated trust, credibility, and brand value that influences stakeholder behavior toward the organization.

variables.name: Legal risk exposure
variables.description: Measures the likelihood and potential magnitude of legal claims, litigation costs, fines, and disclosure-related liabilities.

variables.name: Regulatory scrutiny
variables.description: Measures the intensity and scope of oversight, inquiries, and investigatory activity by policy and regulatory actors.

variables.name: Policy uncertainty
variables.description: Measures the degree of ambiguity and unpredictability in policy and regulatory outcomes affecting the sector.

variables.name: Geopolitical tension
variables.description: Measures the level of interstate strategic friction and security rivalry that can affect technology and trade links.

variables.name: Supply-chain concentration
variables.description: Measures the extent to which critical inputs, manufacturing, or capabilities are concentrated among few suppliers or locations.

variables.name: Information-security vulnerability
variables.description: Measures the system's susceptibility to espionage, data compromise, and unauthorized access to sensitive information.

variables.name: Disclosure transparency
variables.description: Measures the clarity, completeness, and timeliness of public and internal disclosures about risks and governance actions.

catalysts.title: Nvidia board probe report
catalysts.description: The board concludes and publishes findings from its probe into the CEO's relationship and any espionage implications.
catalysts.rationale: Board will probe CEO relationship ("Nvidia’s board will probe CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship...", 2026-11-08).

catalysts.title: Congressional hearing / summons of Jensen Huang
catalysts.description: US lawmakers schedule hearings or formally summon Jensen Huang to testify about alleged ties to a Chinese spy.
catalysts.rationale: Lawmakers have summoned Huang and demand answers ("US lawmakers summon Jensen Huang...", 2026-11-08; "House Democratic leader says lawmakers need answers...", 2026-11-10).

catalysts.title: FBI public confirmation / formal probe
catalysts.description: The FBI opens or publicly confirms a formal investigation into the CEO's alleged contacts with a Chinese intelligence-linked individual.
catalysts.rationale: Reports and political comments indicate FBI involvement ("Trump says FBI is ‘looking into’ Nvidia’s Jensen Huang", 2026-11-10; "US believes Nvidia’s Huang...", 2026-11-08).

catalysts.title: Securities and shareholder litigation proceeds
catalysts.description: Filed suits and potential class actions move into discovery, motions, and settlement/decision phases.
catalysts.rationale: Lawsuit already filed over disclosures ("Nvidia, CEO Huang sued over disclosures related to suspected Chinese spy", 2026-11-10).

catalysts.title: Legislation tightening China's access to AI chips
catalysts.description: Policymakers pursue rules or laws further restricting China's access to advanced AI chips and related technologies.
catalysts.rationale: Coverage expects laws to tighten China's access to AI chips ("Nvidia spy allegations likely to spur laws to tighten China's access to AI chips", 2026-11-10).

catalysts.title: Derivatives repositioning and large option trades
catalysts.description: Large block trades and new derivative products increase open interest, leverage, and contingent positions tied to Nvidia.
catalysts.rationale: Reports of massive trades and new products tied to the scandal ("A massive trade in Nvidia just went off...", 2026-11-09; "Weekend trading... new financial products", 2026-11-09).

catalysts.title: Elevated stock volatility and price swings
catalysts.description: Nvidia share-price swings and sector volatility persist as news flow and trades drive rapid repricing and spillovers to peers.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines show immediate share slumps and market reactions ("Nvidia stock falls 5%...", 2026-11-09; "Nvidia Shares Slump", 2026-11-10).

catalysts.title: Capital rotation toward AMD / Broadcom
catalysts.description: Investors reallocate to perceived beneficiaries (AMD, Broadcom) as Nvidia leadership uncertainty raises relative downside risks.
catalysts.rationale: Analysts flag AMD/Broadcom as near-term beneficiaries ("Analyzing AMD as a near-term beneficiary...", 2026-11-09; "Are AMD and Broadcom the real winners...", 2026-11-09).

catalysts.title: Nvidia public disclosures and SEC filings
catalysts.description: Nvidia issues formal disclosures (8-Ks, investor letters) updating shareholders about the probe, risks, and remediation steps.
catalysts.rationale: Coverage expects corporate disclosures about the investigation ("What to Know About Nvidia’s Investigation...", 2026-11-09; board probe headlines, 2026-11-08/09).

catalysts.title: Potential Jensen Huang resignation or removal
catalysts.description: Low-probability outcome where the CEO resigns or is removed, triggering formal leadership transition processes.
catalysts.rationale: Discussion of Huang's survivability and low exit odds ("Can Jensen Huang survive..." and "exit odds are low on prediction markets...", 2026-11-09).

catalysts.title: Sustained and amplified media coverage
catalysts.description: Ongoing intense news and social-media coverage continues to amplify developments and drive rapid information flow.
catalysts.rationale: High volume of coverage and commentary across outlets and formats (multiple headlines on probe, admissions, and reactions, 2026-11-08 to 11-10).
